repos.description: Single-file deterministic, hash-chained governance kernel: tamper-evident execution lineage, immutable state, DAG checkpoints, and opt-in fail-closed execution recording.

One archived Gemini transcript: nine 'System Architecture and Integration Report' JSON payloads, plus real code extracted verbatim from their code_modules. Payloads carry two baked-in corruptions; most don't parse as JSON. See PROVENANCE.md / README.md.

Independently audits hiring decisions from an Applicant Tracking System for geographic, demographic-proxy, and volatility bias plus audit fraud; packages EEOC-style evidence; logs to a hash-chained governance kernel. A domain-independent governance architecture, demonstrated through hiring.

Closed-loop behavioural simulation used as a governance screen: controllers plus a learning policy steer a noisy value toward a moving target under guardrails. Veto-only by design — a simulation may refuse and may never approve. Renamed from FORTRESS.
Dependency-free executable constitutional-governance layer for AI continuity: provenance, epistemic state, evidence, human authority, historical lineage
Structured archive of my ChatGPT conversation history — 863 conversations (2023–2026) from the account data export, plus derived analysis. See PROVENANCE.md.

Archived single-turn AI transcript: a pasted 'CITADEL v1.1' deterministic LLM-output enforcement engine (regex detection + scoring/rewrite) and the AI's prose audit of it. Includes readable splits of the flattened paste plus a v1.2 with one extra check. See PROVENANCE.md.

Private archive of a Claude.ai account data export (265 conversations, 10,721 messages) with a reproducible extraction pipeline: per-conversation transcripts, deterministic + genuine-AI summaries, and a manifest, all regenerated by scripts/process.py.
Archived AI chat transcript: a content-polish/IVR code paste split into modules by Gemini. Non-executing raw material — see PROVENANCE.md.
Independently testable hostile baseline that checks whether machine-mediated transformations preserve protected epistemic and provenance distinctions

LLM output quality gate: validates generated text against linguistic constraints (no first-person pronouns, no speculative language, requires empirical support) and retries with recalibration feedback. Stdlib-only, async, HMAC-signed output. Descends from the CODE repo's filter classes; see PROVENANCE.md.

Private archive of a Microsoft Copilot activity export (4,242 messages, 369 conversations, Feb 2025-May 2026) with a reproducible extraction pipeline: chronological transcripts, deterministic summaries, and a manifest, all regenerated by scripts/process.py.
ARCHIVED, superseded. The pre-cleanup predecessor of the EDDP repo (shared history through 6dd34d3); EDDP carried the work forward and is the living version. Kept for provenance only.

Local RAG-based technical memory: ingests chat exports, PDFs, and Python source into a chunked, gitignore-aware corpus, queried via Ollama + ChromaDB. Working prototype — no persisted identity, provenance, or temporal model yet.

ARCHIVED. Preserved artifacts from an AI-assisted refactoring session, plus a small wired-together fail-closed data pipeline (telemetry guardrail, HMAC ingestion auth, 8-module assessment/dispatch). A collection with shared provenance, not one product; see README inventory.
Experimental unified governance kernel integrating adaptive, stability & energy-based control strategies with shared integrity guardrails.

Source-controlled forensic archaeology of a Gemini Apps Activity export (4,911 records, Nov 2025–Jul 2026): immutable raw source, normalized datasets, evidence ledger, entity/lineage graphs, and per-system root investigations (VSA, Citadel, Fortress, GSA, governance kernel). Private research artifact.

ARCHIVED, incomplete. Raw Google Takeout export of Gemini activity (190 files; 4,911-record myactivity.json). Processing pipeline was never finished — see README. Forensic analysis of the same activity data lives in Gemini_Extraction.

Executable reconstruction baseline from the GEMS-FER-1.0 forensic package: typed multi-Gem contracts, router, workflow coordinator, human-authority boundaries, TIE adapter, Triad+42 review (see docs/RECONSTRUCTION_STATUS.md). transport/ is a separate unwired salvage: an enforced conservation_kernel gateway + 20-attack corpus.
Codebase integrity toolkit that detects structural ghosts, documentation drift, duplication, dead code & parallel implementations for human review.
Minimal governance gateway enforcing validated artifacts, provenance continuity, authority constraints, and fail-closed submission boundaries.

Consolidation workspace: the from-facts/ cached-signature GRAPH processing code plus the gaps-kernel/ seven-layer governance pipeline, brought together as an integration baseline. Name provisional; an architectural baseline, not a finished product.
Governed execution and learning architecture for controlled AI action, incorporating evidence, authorization & governance constraints.
Archived Gemini transcript — GSA (Governance Systems Architecture) Master Kernel; split out of GSA-815
Evidence-preserving natural-language interpretation layer for extracting, binding, validating, and handing off candidate claims.
Governed innovation operating system for capturing, connecting, evaluating, reviewing, approving & developing ideas through traceable decision workflows.

Archived Gemini transcript: a 30-turn Kaggle debugging session building an image-texture classifier (Sobel/LBP/GLCM features + LightGBM) for the FREUID 2026 IJCAI-ECAI challenge. 14 extracted notebook fragments; see PROVENANCE.md.
Governance observability and monitoring layer for tracking system behavior, outcomes, drift, evidence & post-execution state.
Perception and governance orchestration layer for evaluating incoming artifacts through structured evidence and multi-gate decision processes.
Evidence-based resume and professional-record system preserving source provenance, human promotion decisions & validated document state.
Governed AI execution framework for evidence-bound processing, approval, auditability, and controlled downstream action.
ARCHIVED. Python repository-analysis experiment; most of the module tree was unimplemented stubs. The working parts (gitignore-aware scanner, Python AST chunking) were salvaged into the Ecology repo.

Archived single-turn AI transcript ('Thoughts?' -> a Node.js docx-generator script embedding a theoretical whitepaper: 'Transparent Binary Constraint Architecture — trust-enabling AI via binary constraints at module interfaces'). Script does not run (stripped backticks). See PROVENANCE.md.
Reconstructed Transcript Intelligence Engine baseline for evidence-preserving ingestion, reconstruction, validation, identity, relationships & typed handoff.

Specimen corpus, not a system. Real code, really damaged, with independently-known correct answers — the ecosystem's only non-synthetic ground truth for scoring verifiers. Five reconstruction pairs, a version progression, and five named failure modes including a file that imports cleanly and defines nothing. Renamed from GSA-GATEWAY.

An advisory harness that governs a four-stage review — Red (adversarial), Gray (structural), Green (real-world grounding), 42 (novelty synthesis) — enforcing stage order, epistemic labels, severity accumulation, and append-only provenance. It disciplines and records the review; a human or model does the reasoning.

Preserved VANGUARD architectural baseline (moved from DGK): a ~45-line perimeter-gate wrapper sketch that delegates to GSA-GATEWAY governance classes, plus a flattened, non-reconstructed behavioral-simulation file. Neither runs standalone.
